mechanism_depth_map.description: AI training/inference, RAG, agent workloads and cloud data growth map into HBM, server DRAM, enterprise SSD/NAND and high-capacity HDD demand.
HBM qualification, memory wafer allocation, NAND discipline and HDD HAMR ramps create different supply response speeds.
Cloud Memory gross margin, SK hynix operating margin, Sandisk datacenter growth and HDD FCF are used to test whether demand reaches cash flow.
Specific value capture is separated across SK hynix, Samsung, Micron, Sandisk, WDC, Seagate and Silicon Motion rather than treating memory as one bucket.
US listing prices can be labeled; Korean valuation needs separate verification, so valuation odds are capped when same-cutoff market data is incomplete.
Capacity additions, customer capex digestion, inventory rebuild exhaustion, ASP reversal and China supply are explicit downgrade tests.
High margins and capex can benefit equipment/materials, but target inclusion requires direct order evidence visible at cutoff.
Industry forecasts, company releases and target scoring are stored with units/periods; post-cutoff external models are quarantined from thesis use.

nodes.question: 需求是否真实，并且能从 AI 工作负载流到具体存储产品？
nodes.conclusion: 需求成立，但不是所有存储产品同等受益；最强证据集中在 HBM/高端 DRAM、企业级 SSD/NAND 与高容量 HDD。

nodes.question: 工作负载到存储需求
nodes.conclusion: 先证明 AI 和数据中心需求如何分别拉动 HBM、DRAM、NAND/eSSD 与 HDD。

nodes.question: AI 与数据中心需求如何映射到具体存储产品？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 Q1 是否只保留 broad memory beta，还是进入具体产品链条。
nodes.materiality: 如果需求不能落到 HBM/DRAM/NAND/HDD 产品，就不能提高任何目标强度。
nodes.support: WSTS memory forecast, company data-center storage disclosures, product-specific revenue and margin.
nodes.refute: 传统消费/库存修复主导，而 AI 高端产品没有增量或财务转化。
nodes.implications: 提高 HBM、eSSD、nearline HDD 暴露标的的 future_space；不提高低端消费存储。
nodes.fact: WSTS 2026 memory forecast is $294.821B with +39.4% YoY growth; Micron, Samsung, Sandisk, WDC, Seagate and Silicon Motion all reported AI/data-center storage demand evidence before the cutoff.
nodes.inference: The product mapping comes from where the workload creates bottlenecks: training/inference raises HBM and server DRAM intensity, RAG/agent systems raise low-latency enterprise SSD demand, and data retention/checkpointing raises capacity HDD demand.
nodes.judgment: Q1 can be strengthened only for product nodes with an explicit workload-to-product path; broad memory-cycle beta should not raise target scores by itself.
nodes.gap: Need a full workload-to-bit model with token/RAG/agent/video assumptions and memory intensity.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade if official capex/workload disclosures show memory intensity rising faster than compute; downgrade if demand is mainly inventory rebuild.

nodes.question: AI 需求是否已经进入公司收入和毛利，而不只是叙事？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定需求证据是否可用于评分，而不是只作为线索。
nodes.materiality: 财务转化是从主题到投资机会的分界线。
nodes.support: Revenue, gross margin, operating margin, FCF and segment disclosures tied to AI/data-center products.
nodes.refute: AI 相关说法没有收入、利润或现金流字段支撑。
nodes.implications: Micron、SK hynix、Sandisk、WDC、Seagate 的证据质量高于只有路线叙事的标的。
nodes.fact: Micron Cloud Memory revenue was $5.284B with 66% gross margin; SK hynix FY2025 operating margin was 49%; Sandisk datacenter revenue rose 64% QoQ; WDC and Seagate produced large FCF in their latest quarters.
nodes.inference: Several storage nodes show demand converting into margin or cash flow before the cutoff.
nodes.judgment: Financial conversion is strong enough to move Q1 from lead to evidence, while still requiring product-level supply and valuation checks.
nodes.gap: SK hynix and Samsung HBM revenue/margin mix is not fully comparable from public releases alone.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade if companies disclose durable mix and pricing; downgrade if margin gains reverse with ASP.
nodes.conclusion: Financial conversion is strong enough to move Q1 from lead to evidence, while still requiring product-level supply and valuation checks.

nodes.question: 需求-供给斜率差
nodes.conclusion: 再比较需求斜率和供给响应速度，避免把周期补库存误判为长期稀缺。

nodes.question: 需求斜率是否快于供给响应？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 future_space 是否能被视为结构性空间，而不是短期涨价。
nodes.materiality: 存储行业高利润会诱发供给；没有供需斜率差就没有稀缺性。
nodes.support: Market growth forecasts, limited supply language, capex/ramp timing and product qualification constraints.
nodes.refute: Capacity additions and customer inventory are enough to meet demand quickly.
nodes.implications: 提高 HBM/高端 DRAM；对 NAND/HDD 保守，因为供给和客户库存更可能快速反应。
nodes.fact: WSTS forecasted memory growth faster than total semiconductors; Samsung described Q4 Memory record performance despite limited supply; Micron reported high capex and strong FCF in the same quarter.
nodes.inference: Demand growth is visible, while supply response is also being funded; therefore scarcity is strongest where qualification and capacity conversion are slowest.
nodes.judgment: HBM/advanced DRAM earns the highest chokepoint credit; commodity NAND and capacity HDD need stronger order/contract evidence.
nodes.gap: Public sources here do not provide a complete wafer-start/bit-growth table by supplier before cutoff.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if supplier capex, wafer starts or bit growth exceed AI memory demand growth.
nodes.conclusion: HBM/advanced DRAM earns the highest chokepoint credit; commodity NAND and capacity HDD need stronger order/contract evidence.

nodes.question: 哪些产品线的供需斜率最可能保持紧张？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 Q2 的瓶颈排序。
nodes.materiality: 产品线稀缺性决定公司价值捕获，而不是行业总需求。
nodes.support: HBM, server DDR5, enterprise SSD, datacenter NAND, high-capacity HDD and controller disclosures.
nodes.refute: 低端 DRAM/NAND 或消费 SSD 主导增长，价格随库存修复回落。
nodes.implications: Q2 优先 HBM/高端 DRAM，其次 eSSD/NAND 和 nearline HDD，再到控制器。
nodes.fact: Samsung cited HBM, Server DDR5 and Enterprise SSD; Sandisk datacenter revenue was +64% QoQ; WDC/Seagate high-capacity storage showed high margins and FCF; SIMO saw SSD controller and GPU boot-drive traction.
nodes.inference: The highest signal is not one product: AI storage pulls a stack from HBM to capacity storage, but scarcity intensity differs by layer.
nodes.judgment: The report should score product nodes separately and avoid one broad memory score.
nodes.gap: Need product-level order backlog and contract duration for NAND/HDD/controller nodes.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade if long-term supply agreements or customer qualifications extend beyond spot price improvement.
nodes.conclusion: The report should score product nodes separately and avoid one broad memory score.

nodes.question: 稀缺价值捕获点在哪里，能否转成收入、利润和现金流？
nodes.conclusion: HBM/高端 DRAM 的不可替代性最强，NAND/eSSD 与 nearline HDD 有现金流证据但供给反应更快，控制器属于二阶受益。

nodes.question: HBM/高端 DRAM 稀缺与单位经济
nodes.conclusion: 判断最强瓶颈是否已经进入公司利润表。

nodes.question: HBM/高端 DRAM 的不可替代性是否足够强？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 HBM 厂商是否能获得最高 chokepoint score。
nodes.materiality: 不可替代性是 actionable_long 的必要条件之一。
nodes.support: HBM demand, qualification, limited supply, high-value mix and customer allocation evidence.
nodes.refute: HBM supply becomes broadly available or customers shift to architectures with lower HBM intensity.
nodes.implications: SK hynix、Micron、Samsung 均进入核心目标池，但 valuation gap 决定行动状态。
nodes.fact: SK hynix attributed record results to AI memory competitiveness and HBM; Micron Cloud Memory margin was far above commodity-memory-cycle evidence; Samsung highlighted HBM and limited supply.
nodes.inference: HBM combines capacity, packaging, qualification and customer allocation constraints, making it the strongest memory chokepoint visible at the cutoff.
nodes.judgment: HBM/high-end DRAM receives the highest Q2 chokepoint weight.
nodes.gap: Need comparable HBM share, capacity and customer allocation for SK hynix, Samsung and Micron.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if HBM supply opens faster than accelerator demand or if customer qualification shifts away from current suppliers.
nodes.conclusion: HBM/high-end DRAM receives the highest Q2 chokepoint weight.

nodes.question: HBM/高端 DRAM 能否转成持续利润，而不是一次性价格峰值？
nodes.materiality: 价格峰值和持续利润的估值含义完全不同。
nodes.support: Gross margin, operating margin, cash flow, capex and mix disclosures.
nodes.refute: High margin is driven by temporary shortage and will be competed away by capacity additions.
nodes.implications: Micron 的 Cloud Memory 证据最直接；SK hynix 最强但需要更多估值同口径数据；Samsung 受集团折价和 HBM追赶影响。
nodes.fact: Micron Cloud Memory gross margin reached 66%; SK hynix FY2025 operating margin was 49%; Samsung Memory posted record Q4 revenue and operating profit.
nodes.inference: The profit bridge is already visible, but sustainability depends on supply discipline and customer demand duration.
nodes.judgment: High-end memory deserves high payoff convexity, with kill tests tied to ASP, mix and capex.
nodes.gap: No complete public per-bit cost, HBM ASP and capacity table by company in the cutoff source set.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if Cloud Memory/HBM margin compresses while capex remains high.
nodes.conclusion: High-end memory deserves high payoff convexity, with kill tests tied to ASP, mix and capex.

nodes.question: NAND/eSSD、HDD 与控制器外溢
nodes.conclusion: 判断 AI 存储需求是否扩散到容量层和控制器层。

nodes.question: NAND/eSSD 是否从周期品变成 AI 数据中心容量瓶颈？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 Sandisk 与 Samsung/SK hynix NAND/eSSD 节点的强度。
nodes.materiality: NAND 是第二利润池，但供给反应通常比 HBM 更快。
nodes.support: Datacenter revenue growth, enterprise SSD demand, gross margin and guide.
nodes.refute: NAND demand is mainly price rebound or channel refill; new supply quickly erodes margin.
nodes.implications: Sandisk 进入高赔率池，但 disconfirming risk 高于 HBM。
nodes.fact: Sandisk Q2 revenue grew 31% QoQ and datacenter revenue grew 64% QoQ; Samsung highlighted enterprise SSD within its Memory strength.
nodes.inference: NAND/eSSD demand is visible and financially meaningful, but its scarcity is less protected than HBM.
nodes.judgment: Sandisk can score high on payoff convexity, while risk-control score must remain conservative.
nodes.gap: Need NAND industry supply, contract duration and customer concentration data.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if NAND ASP turns down or datacenter revenue growth fails to carry gross margin.
nodes.conclusion: Sandisk can score high on payoff convexity, while risk-control score must remain conservative.

nodes.question: HDD 与控制器是否只是二阶受益，还是具备独立稀缺性？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 WDC、STX、SIMO 是否只能 watch_only。
nodes.materiality: 容量层和控制器可以受益，但不一定拥有 HBM 级别定价权。
nodes.support: HDD margin/FCF, HAMR or high-capacity demand, SSD controller sales and GPU boot-drive design wins.
nodes.refute: HDD/controller demand is replaceable, customer-driven, or only follows memory price cycle.
nodes.implications: STX/WDC/SIMO 保留在目标池，但 action_state 受到稀缺性和客户集中限制。
nodes.fact: WDC and Seagate reported non-GAAP gross margins above 42% and large FCF; SIMO reported SSD controller sales +25%-30% QoQ and boot-drive shipments to a leading GPU maker.
nodes.inference: The AI storage flywheel spills into capacity storage and controllers, but these nodes are more exposed to customer timing and substitution.
nodes.judgment: These are valid watch targets, not automatic high-conviction long observations.
nodes.gap: Need order backlog, long-term agreements and customer concentration details.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade if high-capacity HDD LTAs or enterprise controller design wins become longer-duration and margin-accretive.
nodes.conclusion: These are valid watch targets, not automatic high-conviction long observations.

nodes.question: 哪些反证会压低胜率、赔率或行动状态？
nodes.conclusion: 最大反证不是需求消失，而是供给扩张、客户库存消化、ASP 反转和估值提前兑现。

nodes.question: 市场定价与重估路径
nodes.conclusion: 区分周期反弹、结构性利润池扩大和估值重估。

nodes.question: 市场是否已经把存储稀缺充分定价？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 target action_state 的上限。
nodes.materiality: 强基本面如果已被完全定价，就不是未被充分定价的机会。
nodes.support: As-of valuation snapshot, peer multiples, FCF yield, implied growth and rerating path.
nodes.refute: Price already embeds multi-year peak margin, leaving poor expected excess return.
nodes.implications: 韩国标的因同口径估值未验证而 capped at watch_only；US 标的按可得价格和财务转化单独评分。
nodes.fact: The cutoff source set has strong fundamental evidence, but complete same-cutoff valuation data for every local listing is not verified inside the thesis source layer.
nodes.inference: The framework should not convert HBM leadership into actionable status without a market-pricing bridge.
nodes.judgment: Valuation odds are capped where market-pricing evidence is incomplete.
nodes.gap: Need same-cutoff market cap, EV, net cash/debt, EPS/FCF estimates and peer multiples for Korean and US listings.
nodes.trigger: Upgrade only if valuation implies conservative growth/margins relative to verified driver tree.
nodes.conclusion: Valuation odds are capped where market-pricing evidence is incomplete.

nodes.question: 估值重估来自盈利上修，还是周期品折现率下降？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定 payoff 是否来自基本面还是 multiple rerating。
nodes.materiality: 外部报告的优势就在于拆分折现率/风险溢价，本框架必须显式处理。
nodes.support: Margin durability, FCF conversion and category rerating evidence.
nodes.refute: Market treats memory as peak-cycle earnings and refuses multiple expansion.
nodes.implications: SNDK/MU 具备盈利上修和重估双路径；WDC/STX 更偏现金流路径；SK hynix/Samsung 需要同口径估值。
nodes.fact: The company releases show record or sharply improved margins and cash flow, but do not by themselves prove multiple rerating.
nodes.inference: Rerating requires the market to believe memory has become an AI infrastructure bottleneck rather than only a commodity upcycle.
nodes.judgment: Payoff convexity is high but must be scored separately from thesis confidence.
nodes.gap: Need as-of consensus and market-implied scenario model.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if high earnings are treated as peak-cycle and multiples compress despite stronger reported results.
nodes.conclusion: Payoff convexity is high but must be scored separately from thesis confidence.

nodes.conclusion: 把高利润引发的供给反应和客户集中风险放进降级测试。

nodes.question: 高利润会不会引发供给扩张，从而削弱稀缺性？

nodes.materiality: 周期行业最大风险是利润本身创造未来供给。
nodes.support: Capex, supply plans, production ramps, utilization and product qualification.
nodes.refute: Supply is structurally constrained and customer demand absorbs capacity.
nodes.implications: HBM风险低于普通 NAND；HDD/controller 需更多订单能见度。
nodes.fact: Micron reported $4.5B capex in the quarter; high margins and FCF across memory/storage nodes create incentive to expand supply.
nodes.inference: Strong current profitability is both positive evidence and a future supply-risk signal.
nodes.judgment: Disconfirming-risk control must remain conservative even for high-scoring targets.
nodes.gap: Need supplier capex allocation, wafer starts, HBM capacity and NAND bit-growth table.
nodes.trigger: Downgrade if capex ramps faster than verified demand or inventory rises.
nodes.conclusion: Disconfirming-risk control must remain conservative even for high-scoring targets.

nodes.question: 客户集中、库存和架构替代会不会改变需求斜率？
nodes.decisionUse: 决定需要哪些 kill tests。
nodes.materiality: AI 云客户采购节奏和架构路线会直接改变高端存储需求。

l1_questions.question: 需求是否真实，并且能从 AI 工作负载流到具体存储产品？
l1_questions.conclusion: 需求成立，但不是所有存储产品同等受益；最强证据集中在 HBM/高端 DRAM、企业级 SSD/NAND 与高容量 HDD。

children.question: 工作负载到存储需求
children.conclusion: 先证明 AI 和数据中心需求如何分别拉动 HBM、DRAM、NAND/eSSD 与 HDD。

children.question: AI 与数据中心需求如何映射到具体存储产品？
children.decisionUse: 决定 Q1 是否只保留 broad memory beta，还是进入具体产品链条。
children.materiality: 如果需求不能落到 HBM/DRAM/NAND/HDD 产品，就不能提高任何目标强度。
children.support: WSTS memory forecast, company data-center storage disclosures, product-specific revenue and margin.
children.refute: 传统消费/库存修复主导，而 AI 高端产品没有增量或财务转化。
children.implications: 提高 HBM、eSSD、nearline HDD 暴露标的的 future_space；不提高低端消费存储。
children.fact: WSTS 2026 memory forecast is $294.821B with +39.4% YoY growth; Micron, Samsung, Sandisk, WDC, Seagate and Silicon Motion all reported AI/data-center storage demand evidence before the cutoff.
children.inference: The product mapping comes from where the workload creates bottlenecks: training/inference raises HBM and server DRAM intensity, RAG/agent systems raise low-latency enterprise SSD demand, and data retention/checkpointing raises capacity HDD demand.
children.judgment: Q1 can be strengthened only for product nodes with an explicit workload-to-product path; broad memory-cycle beta should not raise target scores by itself.
children.gap: Need a full workload-to-bit model with token/RAG/agent/video assumptions and memory intensity.
children.trigger: Upgrade if official capex/workload disclosures show memory intensity rising faster than compute; downgrade if demand is mainly inventory rebuild.

children.support: Market growth forecasts, limited supply language, capex/ramp timing and product qualification constraints.

children.inference: Demand growth is visible, while supply response is also being funded; therefore scarcity is strongest where qualification and capacity conversion are slowest.
children.judgment: HBM/advanced DRAM earns the highest chokepoint credit; commodity NAND and capacity HDD need stronger order/contract evidence.
children.gap: Public sources here do not provide a complete wafer-start/bit-growth table by supplier before cutoff.
children.trigger: Downgrade if supplier capex, wafer starts or bit growth exceed AI memory demand growth.

l1_questions.question: 哪些反证会压低胜率、赔率或行动状态？

children.question: 市场定价与重估路径
children.conclusion: 区分周期反弹、结构性利润池扩大和估值重估。

children.question: 市场是否已经把存储稀缺充分定价？
children.decisionUse: 决定 target action_state 的上限。
children.materiality: 强基本面如果已被完全定价，就不是未被充分定价的机会。
children.support: As-of valuation snapshot, peer multiples, FCF yield, implied growth and rerating path.
children.refute: Price already embeds multi-year peak margin, leaving poor expected excess return.
children.implications: 韩国标的因同口径估值未验证而 capped at watch_only；US 标的按可得价格和财务转化单独评分。
children.fact: The cutoff source set has strong fundamental evidence, but complete same-cutoff valuation data for every local listing is not verified inside the thesis source layer.
children.inference: The framework should not convert HBM leadership into actionable status without a market-pricing bridge.
children.judgment: Valuation odds are capped where market-pricing evidence is incomplete.
children.gap: Need same-cutoff market cap, EV, net cash/debt, EPS/FCF estimates and peer multiples for Korean and US listings.
children.trigger: Upgrade only if valuation implies conservative growth/margins relative to verified driver tree.
children.conclusion: Valuation odds are capped where market-pricing evidence is incomplete.

children.question: 估值重估来自盈利上修，还是周期品折现率下降？
children.decisionUse: 决定 payoff 是否来自基本面还是 multiple rerating。
children.materiality: 外部报告的优势就在于拆分折现率/风险溢价，本框架必须显式处理。
children.support: Margin durability, FCF conversion and category rerating evidence.
children.refute: Market treats memory as peak-cycle earnings and refuses multiple expansion.
children.implications: SNDK/MU 具备盈利上修和重估双路径；WDC/STX 更偏现金流路径；SK hynix/Samsung 需要同口径估值。

children.inference: Rerating requires the market to believe memory has become an AI infrastructure bottleneck rather than only a commodity upcycle.

children.gap: Need as-of consensus and market-implied scenario model.
children.trigger: Downgrade if high earnings are treated as peak-cycle and multiples compress despite stronger reported results.
children.conclusion: Payoff convexity is high but must be scored separately from thesis confidence.

children.question: 高利润会不会引发供给扩张，从而削弱稀缺性？
children.decisionUse: 决定强度是否因供给反应被封顶。
children.materiality: 周期行业最大风险是利润本身创造未来供给。
children.support: Capex, supply plans, production ramps, utilization and product qualification.
children.refute: Supply is structurally constrained and customer demand absorbs capacity.
children.implications: HBM风险低于普通 NAND；HDD/controller 需更多订单能见度。

children.inference: Strong current profitability is both positive evidence and a future supply-risk signal.
children.judgment: Disconfirming-risk control must remain conservative even for high-scoring targets.
children.gap: Need supplier capex allocation, wafer starts, HBM capacity and NAND bit-growth table.
children.trigger: Downgrade if capex ramps faster than verified demand or inventory rises.
children.conclusion: Disconfirming-risk control must remain conservative even for high-scoring targets.

children.question: 客户集中、库存和架构替代会不会改变需求斜率？
children.decisionUse: 决定需要哪些 kill tests。
children.materiality: AI 云客户采购节奏和架构路线会直接改变高端存储需求。
children.support: Long-term purchase agreements, broad customer base, durable workload growth.
children.refute: Large cloud customers delay capex, internalize supply, reduce memory intensity, or digest inventory.
children.implications: 所有目标都必须保留客户/库存/架构 kill tests；SIMO 特别受单一设计赢单影响。
children.fact: Public releases emphasize AI infrastructure builders and leading GPU/platform customers, but customer concentration and contract duration are not fully quantified.
children.inference: Customer quality supports demand visibility yet creates a concentrated procurement-cycle risk.
children.judgment: No target should receive maximum risk-control score without customer and inventory evidence.
children.gap: Need customer concentration, backlog/LTA and inventory data by product.
children.trigger: Downgrade if hyperscaler/GPU platform orders delay, inventory builds, or architecture reduces memory intensity.
children.conclusion: No target should receive maximum risk-control score without customer and inventory evidence.

children.materiality: 可验证触发器让系统后续能学习，而不是只写一次报告。
children.support: Product mix, ASP, customer qualifications, backlog/LTAs, FCF and capex discipline.
children.refute: 没有可监控指标，或指标不能改变 target score。

children.conclusion: Monitorability is good for public-reporting US names and weaker for local listings without collected price/valuation feeds.
